info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Relations Management API
info.description: The Merchant Relations Management API facilitates the establishment and maintenance of relationships between merchants and the banking system. This endpoint supports the creation of new merchant profiles, enabling businesses to efficiently manage their merchant data and enhance transaction processes. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and payment processing companies that require robust management of merchant relations for compliance and operational efficiency. By using this API, businesses can streamline their interactions with merchants and improve service delivery.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and establish relationships with merchants. It enables businesses to manage their interactions and agreements with various merchants effectively.
